scope: Archived memory component ablation, 2K/4K H100; independent temporal-only rerun separated

charts.title: Ablation: task success at 2K and 4K
charts.note: Experiment: 11 Nov 2026; Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite; horizon=100 turns. 40 base tasks x 2 repeats per condition; repeats are not independent tasks. Legacy v1.0.3 no_temporal removes BOTH temporal resolution and mandatory state. Error bars: reported sample-cluster bootstrap 95% CI. Matched 2K/4K outcomes are identical; do not pool as independent tasks. A zero-width empirical CI does not imply zero population uncertainty.
charts.description_ko: 2K와 4K에서 Full과 네 제거 조건을 비교합니다. 두 예산의 400개 대응 실행은 같은 결과였으며, v1.0.3의 No temporal은 필수 상태 보존도 함께 제거했습니다.

charts.title: Ablation: memory preservation and behavior reliability
charts.note: Experiment: 11 Nov 2026; Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite; horizon=100 turns. 40 base tasks x 2 repeats per condition; repeats are not independent tasks. Legacy v1.0.3 no_temporal removes BOTH temporal resolution and mandatory state. 2K means and saved 95% CI; 4K means match. Context correctness and action correctness are distinct. All action-level constraint violations are 0/40; this does not guarantee perfect memory retention.
charts.description_ko: 보호 기억 회수, 시간 문맥 정확성, 실제 상태 사용, 오래된 상태 사용을 나눠 보여줍니다. 성공률이 높아도 보호 기억 보존이 낮아질 수 있습니다.

charts.title: Ablation: paired success differences and 95% CI
charts.note: Experiment: 11 Nov 2026; Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite; horizon=100 turns. 40 base tasks x 2 repeats per condition; repeats are not independent tasks. Legacy v1.0.3 no_temporal removes BOTH temporal resolution and mandatory state. 2K: 80 sample/repeat pairs, clustered by 40 base tasks; 2,000 bootstrap resamples, seed 42. All intervals touch or include zero; no multiplicity adjustment or equivalence test.
charts.description_ko: 같은 과제와 반복을 맞춘 Full − 제거 조건의 차이입니다. 저장된 짝지은 신뢰구간이 모두 0에 닿거나 포함하므로 확정적 우위나 동등성으로 해석하지 않습니다.

charts.title: Ablation: peak input and cumulative output tokens
charts.note: Experiment: 11 Nov 2026; Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite; horizon=100 turns. 40 base tasks x 2 repeats per condition; repeats are not independent tasks. Legacy v1.0.3 no_temporal removes BOTH temporal resolution and mandatory state. Saved 2K means and 95% CI; 4K means match. Input is a per-run maximum single context, not cumulative provider prompt usage. Output is cumulative across all calls in a run.
charts.description_ko: 왼쪽 입력은 실행별 최대 단일 Context의 평균이고, 오른쪽 출력은 실행 전체 누적 출력의 평균입니다. 입력 곡선을 여러 호출의 누적 입력량으로 읽으면 안 됩니다.

charts.title: Ablation: estimated generation cost and recorded latency
charts.note: Experiment: 11 Nov 2026; Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite; horizon=100 turns. 40 base tasks x 2 repeats per condition; repeats are not independent tasks. Legacy v1.0.3 no_temporal removes BOTH temporal resolution and mandatory state. Cost bars use saved 95% CI scaled to 1,000 runs; this is a rate, not an actual 1,000-run experiment or total bill. Latency bars have no invented CI; OS and commit differ, so differences are not a causal budget effect.
charts.description_ko: 실행당 생성 비용과 두 실행 환경에서의 지연 시간을 비교합니다. 2K와 4K의 OS·commit이 달라 지연 차이를 예산 효과로 해석하지 않습니다.

charts.title: Ablation: retrieval and overlapping failure diagnostics
charts.note: Experiment: 11 Nov 2026; Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite; horizon=100 turns. 40 base tasks x 2 repeats per condition; repeats are not independent tasks. Legacy v1.0.3 no_temporal removes BOTH temporal resolution and mandatory state. 2K means; 4K means match. Recall/precision/MRR are multiplied by 100. Constraint violations use n=40; remaining shown diagnostics use n=80. Failure metrics overlap and must not be summed. Cells are vector shapes.
charts.description_ko: 초기 검색 점수와 선택·상태·제약 실패를 함께 비교합니다. 실패 지표는 서로 겹칠 수 있으며, 적용 분모는 CSV에 기록했습니다.

charts.title: Temporal ablation: corrected mandatory-state-preserving rerun
charts.note: Experiment: 11 Nov 2026; 2K/H100. Success bars: saved/reported cluster-bootstrap 95% CI; no stale-use CI was reported for corrected rerun. 80/80 legacy/corrected outcome pairs and selected ID sets match. Corrected vs historical Full: +7.5 pp, 95% CI [-2.5,+17.5]; not a concurrent rerun of all variants.
charts.description_ko: 필수 상태 보존을 복구한 v1.0.4의 Temporal 단독 제거 결과를 기존 조건과 구분합니다. 수정 전후 80쌍의 성공 판정과 최종 선택 기억 집합은 같았지만, 일반적인 기능 불필요성을 입증한 결과는 아닙니다.

limitations: Current freeze 1.0.6 and topic_balanced_v3 config are not the experiment configuration.
11 Nov ablation results are separate from 17 Nov safety-gate recovery and input-generation QA.
The v1.0.3 temporal ablation removes two components; v1.0.4 temporal-only rerun is separate.
4K values come from the published comparison report; 2K values from canonical checked-in aggregates.
Existing confidence intervals are preserved. No raw runs or new confidence intervals were reconstructed.
No experiments or model calls were made. 40 shared base tasks, not 800 independent tasks.
